item.title: Spotify Tests AI-Powered Prompted Playlists
item.description: Sarah Perez, writing for TechCrunch: The new tool allows users to describe what they want to hear in a personalized playlist that reflects the “full arc” of their tastes, according to the company. That means the playlist focuses not only on the songs you like now, but your entire Spotify listening history from day one […]
